A strong Negro movement in the USA will be able to influence and direct the Negro movement in all those backward parts of the world where the Negroes are oppressed by the various imperialist powers." You see what they called all the other places: backward parts of the earth. That is why Esau always has his eye on the American blacks. People ask why Canada and Europe have free healthcare and not America: they do not want the American blacks to get it, because this group here is more dangerous than all the other groups. Sisters, do not just let your boys run out; the white man has his eyes on your sons; they know what stock they come from.

note.label: We Are Born in Babylon

precepts.why:
The hearings said the American Negro is the one who is going to lead all the others, the vanguard of the liberation movement on an international scale. The Bible said it first: “And this is the blessing of Judah: and he said, Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people”.

Esau took the best stock and put them in North America, and the American Economic Association wrote that the Negro stock landed in America was physically superior to the average of that left behind, the soundest and strongest, who transmitted to their offspring their qualities. We didn't write that; the white man wrote that. Judah in America is the one the Lord brings unto his people and helps from his enemies.

precepts.point: For behold, I will shake mine hand upon them, and they shall be a spoil to their servants. Write this down: the servants there is us. Right now we are their servants, but God will shake his hand upon the nations and they shall be a spoil to their servants.

precepts.why:
“And this is the blessing of Judah: and he said, Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah”. Judah is going to be the teachers. “and bring him unto his people”: Judah is the one the spirit comes on first, to go and gather the tribes. “let his hands be sufficient for him; and be thou an help to him from his enemies.”

We just read that, and then we go back to Zechariah: “Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.” The Zion there is Judah, and Moses' blessing lines up with it. That is why the next words of Zechariah are about those enemies: “he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye.” He that touches Israel touches the apple of God's eye. The Lord promised to help Judah from his enemies, and in Zechariah he sends his hand against the nations which spoiled us.

precepts.text: Moses blessed the twelve tribes before his death. Of Joseph he said, blessed of the Lord be his land: the precious things of heaven, the deep that coucheth beneath, the precious fruits brought forth by the sun and the precious things put forth by the moon; there are things on Cuba and Puerto Rico that only come forth by the moon. The goodwill of him that dwelt in the bush: that's Christ. His horns are like the horns of unicorns, meaning the rhinoceros: with them he shall push the people together to the ends of the earth; and they are the ten thousands of Ephraim, and they are the thousands of Manasseh. Ephraim and Manasseh were used instrumentally by God to push the ten tribes from the eastern hemisphere to the western hemisphere.
precepts.point: The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors: what God promised to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob was not yet fulfilled in their day, but Joseph ruled all Egypt. Canaan wasn't ours yet, and Joseph already had the crown.

note.label: Joseph in Egypt: Then & Now

precepts.why:
“And this is the blessing, wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.” Moses blessed the twelve tribes before he died, and his blessing of Joseph matches Jacob's in Genesis 49.

“And of Joseph he said, Blessed of the Lord be his land, for the precious things of heaven, for the dew, and for the deep that coucheth beneath.” That is Jacob's “blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lieth under”: good climate and good weather, and the fish and treasures beneath the waters. “And for the precious fruits brought forth by the sun, and for the precious things put forth by the moon”: there are things on Cuba and Puerto Rico that only come forth by the moon, like the coquí frog that comes out in the time of the moon.

“and for the good will of him that dwelt in the bush”: that is Christ, whose spirit was in the bush. “let the blessing come upon the head of Joseph, and upon the top of the head of him that was separated from his brethren,” just as Jacob said the blessings “shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.”

“His glory is like the firstling of his bullock”: that is Ephraim. “and his horns are like the horns of unicorns,” meaning the rhinoceros: “with them he shall push the people together to the ends of the earth: and they are the ten thousands of Ephraim, and they are the thousands of Manasseh.” That is very important. Ephraim and Manasseh were used instrumentally by God to push the ten tribes from the eastern hemisphere to the western hemisphere.

precepts.text: Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people: bring Judah to all the tribes on an international scale, so we can get out of here.

note.label: The Superiority of the Chosen People

precepts.why:
“Judah is a lion’s whelp.” He was a young lion in the 1960s, and after that he fell and became the old lion: “who shall rouse him up?” Then: “The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.” Shiloh is Christ, and unto him, and to Judah, shall the gathering of the people be. Judah is the essential tribe to bring all twelve tribes together, the very liberation the 1969 hearings feared, which is why they said they had to destroy Judah among the African American community: education, revised Bibles, contraception, autism, using all they can to destroy these negroes.

Deuteronomy 33:7 is Moses’ blessing on the same tribe: “And this is the blessing of Judah: and he said, Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people: let his hands be sufficient for him; and be thou an help to him from his enemies.” Bring Judah unto his people on an international scale: bring Judah to all the tribes, so that we can get out of here. Judah, Benjamin and Levi are giving these devils hell, and all twelve tribes are going to rise up together and bring hell to this kingdom.

It is already happening. A sister in Papua New Guinea wrote to one of our groups that her people thought they were free of colonization after independence in 1975, but religion still holds them colonized, enslaved, trapped and in poverty. Her answer was to go back to the origins of the Bible, obey it, and see what the Lord can do for their country: Genesis 49:8-12, and to listen to the tribe of Judah, who holds the sceptre, whom all tribes shall praise. Our people there know Judah has been sent to revive them.

That is why Judah in America is kept down. Every other tribe, in Jamaica, in Africa, in Europe, Levi speaking six languages, is better educated than Judah here. If Judah knew five or six languages, this thing would be over quickly. So the schools are dumbed down for Judah, while the blessing stands: the Lord will hear Judah’s voice, bring him to his people, and help him against his enemies.

precepts.point: The revised twelve tribe chart was shown in class: Judah includes American blacks and the Igbo of Nigeria; the chart now carries tribes identified across Africa, India, and the islands, from the Falasha of Ethiopia to the Kikuyu of Kenya to the Sefwi Israelites of Ghana, the Fon and Ashanti under Benjamin, the Zulu under Simeon, the Wolof under Zebulun, and more. note.label: Judgement! To Hell with Your Reparations!

precepts.why:
“Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people”. There is Judah in Africa too, but this is speaking of Judah on this side of the earth, in the Western Hemisphere, specifically in the United States of America. Judah in North America is under Esau, who controls the world right now, and with an American passport you can go anywhere in the world. A Jamaican, Haitian or Nigerian passport cannot take you everywhere. That is why we tell you brothers: get your passport.

“The Lord also shall save the tents of Judah first”. God is going to raise up the tribe of Judah first, Judah in America. Then, when it says bring him unto his people, it means Judah will know where God's people are and will go find them. Wherever our people are in Africa, in Japan, in Iran, in India, scattered throughout the four corners of the earth, Judah will be able to identify them, find them, and teach them what God commanded of them.

That is why Genesis 49 speaks mainly of Israel on this side of the world: Judah needed to know who they were first. And it is already happening. The bishops and brothers that travel went into the history of the people, and they found Judah among the Igbo of Nigeria and the tribes scattered across Africa, India and the islands, now written on the revised twelve tribe chart. When people ask how we know, it is because the Lord showed us; the spirit guided us. That is “be thou an help to him from his enemies”: God is a help to Judah, making us find things so we are not guessing, and the chart will keep being updated as the Lord reveals more.

precepts.point: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth. Try talking with your tongue stuck to the roof of your mouth: that is how Christians sound to those who know the Bible, making up doctrines from seminary schools and sounding fine only to other Christians. And you cannot prefer Jerusalem above your chief joy if you do not know you are Israel.

note.label: There Is No Hate Like Christian Love

precepts.why:
The Israelite way of life is structured so that if you lose your nationality, you are also cut off from your heritage. When they strip you of your identity, your laws, statutes and commandments follow it out the door; you stop performing the laws. Ezra prayed for “seed unto our heart, and culture to our understanding”: culture is heritage.

So “If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning.” The right hand is your strength; you usually work with your right hand. Jerusalem is our homeland, the place where you keep the laws and keep the feasts. Forget Jerusalem, and it is like forgetting your ability to work, the thing you know how to do.

Deuteronomy 33:2 shows what is in that right hand: “The Lord came from Sinai, and rose up from Seir unto them; he shined forth from mount Paran, and he came with ten thousands of saints: from his right hand went a fiery law for them.” The law came from God's right hand.

So if you forget your identity, guess what else goes with it? Your way of life, the fiery law. Forgetting Jerusalem and losing the cunning of the right hand is losing the law along with the nationality.

precepts.point: Thy shoes shall be iron and brass. The name Brazil is linked to the Hebrew word for iron, and the continent is rich in it.

note.label: Latinos For Trump: Alien Vs. Predator

precepts.why:
Moses blessed the tribes “before his death”, and of Asher he said “Let Asher be blessed with children; let him be acceptable to his brethren, and let him dip his foot in oil.” Asher is Venezuela, Colombia, Peru, Brazil, from Colombia down to Uruguay. When the conquistadors came to conquer, rob and pillage, many fled into the jungles of the Amazon and grew up without fathers, so they must be made acceptable to their brethren, and we have to go there and save our people in the jungles. And the oil: a brother in Venezuela, asked how Venezuelans and Colombians can benefit from their precious resource, stood right on the oil. The oil is the precious commodity the red man covets so earnestly.

Then verse 25: “Thy shoes shall be iron and brass.” Look up the name Brazil: it is associated with the Hebrew word barzel, meaning iron. It is not a coincidence that the name Brazil means iron in Hebrew; these people know where our people are. Brazil is full of iron, Colombia is full of iron, Venezuela is full of iron, Ecuador is full of iron. Mexico has iron too, but not the same abundance as South America.

“and as thy days, so shall thy strength be.” That is the inheritance of our people in these lands. It is not a coincidence, the names these countries get, for those who do not believe that the northern kingdom is the northern kingdom.

The elders in the 60s and 70s deciphered this without Google or the internet; all they had were the scriptures and history books. Now, in the information age, it is so much plainer. Asher's blessing, children, oil, iron and brass, sits right where the Bible said it would.

precepts.point: The moon is an instrument of the armies above.

note.label: Pope Nicholas & the Moors of Spain

precepts.why:
Moses blesses Joseph: “Blessed of the Lord be his land, for the precious things of heaven, for the dew, and for the deep that coucheth beneath,” “And for the precious fruits brought forth by the sun, and for the precious things put forth by the moon”. Joseph's sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, dwell on islands: the Puerto Ricans and the Cubans, among others.

The precious things of heaven are the rain; the deep that coucheth beneath is the oceans that give riches beneath the waters. There are certain fruits brought forth by the sun, and certain things that come forth only by moonlight on those islands, like the coquí frog, which is nocturnal and comes out especially under the moonlight, making its noise.

That blessing points to the moon at its peak, what they call the full moon today, which is actually the new moon. That is what leads into Ecclesiasticus 43:6: “He made the moon also to serve in her season for a declaration of times, and a sign of the world.”

precepts.text: And this is the blessing, wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death. Who? The children of Israel. And he said, The Lord came from Sinai, and rose up from Seir unto them; he shined forth from mount Paran, and he came with ten thousands of saints. Of who? Of saints. When we were liberated out of Egypt he called them the saints. From his right hand went a fiery law for them. And that is how you know it is not talking about the mixed multitude among them. The fiery law went to the children of Israel only. Yea, he loved the people; all his saints are in thy hand. All these saints, the children of Israel, are in his hand. And they sat down at thy feet; every one shall receive of thy words.
precepts.point: So we must go into the Bible and figure out who the saints are.

note.label: Christians Don't Understand Ephesians 2

precepts.why:
“And this is the blessing, wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.” Who? The children of Israel. “And he said, The Lord came from Sinai, and rose up from Seir unto them; he shined forth from mount Paran, and he came with ten thousands of saints”. Of who? Of saints. When we were liberated out of Egypt, he called them the saints.

“from his right hand went a fiery law for them.” That is how you know it is not talking about the mixed multitude among them: the fiery law went to the children of Israel only. “Yea, he loved the people; all his saints are in thy hand”: all these saints, the children of Israel, are in his hand. “and they sat down at thy feet; every one shall receive of thy words.”

So the saints are the children of Israel, the ones who received the law from his right hand. When Paul writes “to the saints which are at Ephesus”, he means the same people Moses blessed: Israel.

Asher is the so-called Incan Indians of South America, dwelling in the places from Colombia on down, a land known for resources, an abundance of natural riches.

They took every man his sword and did according to the word of Moses without hesitating, and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men. note.label: Deuteronomy 33: The Blessing of Moses, Identifying the Tribes in the Last Days

precepts.why:
“And of Levi he said, Let thy Thummim and thy Urim be with thy holy one”. The Urim and the Thummim were worn in the garment of the high priest: “And thou shalt put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be upon Aaron’s heart, when he goeth in before the Lord: and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel upon his heart before the Lord continually.”

So the blessing of Levi pertains to the Levites, the lineage of Aaron, who bore the judgment of the children of Israel upon his heart with the Urim and the Thummim in the breastplate of judgment.

Massah and Meribah were where the children of Israel chided and tempted the Lord, asking whether he was among them or not. That is the proving and the striving the blessing of Levi looks back to.

precepts.why:

Ecclesiasticus says it of Aaron: “He chose him out of all men living to offer sacrifices to the Lord, incense, and a sweet savour, for a memorial, to make reconciliation for his people.”

And the teaching came with the office: “He gave unto him his commandments, and authority in the statutes of judgments, that he should teach Jacob the testimonies, and inform Israel in his laws.” Sacrifice, incense and reconciliation on one side, teaching Jacob the testimonies and informing Israel in his laws on the other, and both pertained to Aaron's lineage. That is why Levi had no land of their own but dwelt among all the tribes of Israel: they were responsible for making the sacrifices and teaching the laws to the people.

Joseph is Ephraim and Manasseh: Joseph was one of the twelve sons of Jacob, but Jacob put his name on Joseph's two sons, so his grandsons make up two tribes of Israel. When we read of Joseph we are reading of Ephraim and Manasseh. The precious things of heaven are the good weather on their land, and the dew and “the deep that coucheth beneath” go into the seas whose benefits they reap. “the precious fruits brought forth by the sun” are the crops their land grows: mango, papaya, avocado, pineapple, coconut, banana, sugar cane, fruits you cannot grow in north Florida. “the precious things put forth by the moon” go into the coqui, a frog species that exists only in Puerto Rico and comes out at night with its distinct call. “the chief things of the ancient mountains” are the diamonds, gold and silver in their land, and “the precious things of the lasting hills” include the coffee beans that come out of their hills.

Hosea shows what Ephraim said of all that: “And Ephraim said, Yet I am become rich, I have found me out substance: in all my labours they shall find none iniquity in me that were sin.” Hence the very name Puerto Rico, the port of riches. The blessing came “upon the head of Joseph, and upon the top of the head of him that was separated from his brethren”, but like we read earlier, they waxed fat and became prideful as well: yet I am become rich, and in all my labours they shall find none iniquity in me.

That is the glory of the birthright given to Joseph. The firstling belongs to the Most High, and Joseph's glory is like the firstling of his bullock, the portion of the firstborn.

Jacob's name was named on the lads, which is why Ephraim and Manasseh stand as tribes of Israel, and they were to grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth. Ezra gives the account: “Those are the ten tribes, which were carried away prisoners out of their own land in the time of Osea the king, whom Salmanasar the king of Assyria led away captive, and he carried them over the waters, and so came they into another land.”

“But they took this counsel among themselves, that they would leave the multitude of the heathen, and go forth into a further country, where never mankind dwelt”. That is Joseph's horns pushing the people together to the ends of the earth: the ten tribes, headed by Ephraim and Manasseh, going from the east to the west into a further country, and multiplying there in the midst of the hemisphere.

note.label: Deuteronomy 33: The Blessing of Moses, Identifying the Tribes in the Last Days

precepts.why:
Zebulun and Issachar are blessed together, “Rejoice, Zebulun, in thy going out; and, Issachar, in thy tents”, because they would dwell very close, with linked cities at their borders. In the promised land “They shall call the people unto the mountain; there they shall offer sacrifices of righteousness”: they linked up to make sacrifices of righteousness.

But when they linked up on this side of the world as the Aztecs and the Mayans, they erected pyramids and eventually went off and sacrificed to other gods, even human sacrifice. Hosea testifies of that sacrificing: “They sacrifice flesh for the sacrifices of mine offerings, and eat it; but the Lord accepteth them not; now will he remember their iniquity, and visit their sins: they shall return to Egypt.”

“For Israel hath forgotten his Maker, and buildeth temples”. The sacrifices of righteousness at the mountain became sacrifices the Lord does not accept, at temples built by a people that forgot their Maker; so he remembers their iniquity, visits their sins, and sends a fire upon the cities to devour the palaces thereof.

The blessing still shows who they are: “they shall suck of the abundance of the seas, and of treasures hid in the sand”, the gold and silver discovered in their land, which is why the conquistadors were so glad to stumble upon it.

That is why Dan today is not their own tribe but is absorbed into all the other tribes, primarily Benjamin, dwelling in the Caribbean.

Jacob's blessing shows the same tribe: “Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that biteth the horse heels, so that his rider shall fall backward.” Look how the islands are shaped geographically, like a serpent. The adder in the path is seen in the very shape of the land where Dan dwells.
